topics.topic: The Family House: Sitting room, dining, and bedroom maintenance
learningObjectives: Identify functional areas of a family house
Describe daily and weekly cleaning routines for living spaces
Practice arranging furniture for comfort, aesthetics, and safety

topics.topic: Maintenance of Household Linen and Soft Furnishings
learningObjectives: Classify household linen into bed, table, and bathroom linen
Demonstrate stain removal techniques from cotton and synthetic fabrics
Formulate laundry schedules for family bedding and curtains

topics.topic: Food Nutrients: Carbohydrates, proteins, fats, and water balance
learningObjectives: Explain biochemical roles of energy-yielding and body-building foods
Calculate caloric needs based on activity levels and age group
Identify signs of macronutrient malnutrition in growing children

topics.topic: Vitamins and Mineral Salts: Deficiency diseases and preventive diets
learningObjectives: Distinguish between fat-soluble and water-soluble vitamins
State dietary sources and metabolic roles of iron, calcium, and iodine
Explain causes and prevention of scurvy, rickets, and goitre

topics.topic: Food Hygiene and Food Spoilage Microorganisms
learningObjectives: Identify micro-organisms responsible for food spoilage (moulds, yeasts, bacteria)
State conditions promoting microbial multiplication on perishable foods
Apply standard kitchen hygiene protocols to prevent food poisoning

topics.topic: Food Preservation: Sun-drying, smoking, salting, and refrigeration
learningObjectives: Explain principles underlying traditional and modern preservation methods
Compare nutritional retention across sun-drying, smoking, and freezing
Preserve seasonal vegetables and fish using domestic salting techniques

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Food Laboratory Practicals
learningObjectives: Evaluate student mastery of household management and nutrition theory
Conduct practical assessments on table setting and fabric stain removal
Provide individualized remediation on dietary planning calculations

topics.topic: Cooking Methods: Moist heat (boiling, stewing, poaching)
learningObjectives: Demonstrate moist heat culinary techniques using local cooking utensils
Evaluate effect of temperature and timing on tenderizing tough meats
Prepare a balanced Nigerian one-pot pottage using stewing principles

topics.topic: Cooking Methods: Dry heat (baking, roasting, grilling)
learningObjectives: Explain conduction and radiant heat transfer in baking and grilling
Regulate oven temperatures for pastry baking and poultry roasting
Prepare baked snacks using locally available flour composites

topics.topic: Flour Mixtures: Batters, doughs, and raising agents
learningObjectives: Distinguish between pouring batters, coating batters, and stiff doughs
Explain functions of baking powder, yeast, and steam as raising agents
Bake Nigerian meat pies and puff-puff adhering to correct leavening rules

topics.topic: Basic Seams: Plain seam, French seam, and run-and-fell seam
learningObjectives: Differentiate between open and enclosed seam structures
Sew neat plain and French seams on cotton sample calico squares
Select appropriate seams for specific garment types and fabric weights

topics.topic: Comprehensive Termly Revision & Culinary Practical Exhibition
learningObjectives: Review key competencies across nutrition, kitchen hygiene, and needlework
Display completed sewing samplers and pastry creations for grading
Reinforce practical exam time management and safety compliance

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Needlework Portfolio Assessment
learningObjectives: Test theoretical knowledge in Home Economics through objective and essay papers
Score needlework samplers and pastry practicals against standardized rubrics
Compile termly continuous assessment marks for official broadsheet entry
